thread:
Carlos: dropped a compact proposal for the API keys page focused on the one-time reveal and revoke ergonomics. main goals: fewer accidental revokes, clearer download affordance, and keyboard-first flows. mock: https://design.redwood.local/mock/keys-reveal-v1.png

Mei: nice. immediate reaction: make the one-time key panel persistent until user acknowledges. people miss ephemeral toasts. suggest a small modal-like panel anchored to the drawer: heading 'Save this key' + primary 'Download key' + secondary 'I saved it'.

Hannah: agree persistent panel helps. for keyboard users, focus should move into the key textarea on reveal and the Copy button should be tabbable. escape should close the panel and restore focus to the create button.

Irina: accessibility notes: if panel blocks further actions, use role="dialog" aria-modal=true. If non-blocking, role="region" with an accessible name. Copy confirmation should use aria-live="polite" announcing 'Copied to clipboard'. Revoke undo banners should use role="status" + aria-live="assertive" if revoke immediately blocks API calls.

Carlos: what about revoke UX on mobile? currently it's in the overflow right next to Copy. we should separate Danger actions into their own section with larger hit targets. maybe require a confirm checkbox on mobile for revoke to reduce fat-finger taps.

Mei: microcopy thoughts: primary button: 'Create API key' (verb-first). download primary: 'Download key' secondary: 'I saved it'. one-time panel body: 'This key will not be shown again. Save it now.' copy under the download button: 'Tip: store keys in a secrets manager.'

Hannah: undo behavior: inline soft-delete where the row collapses to a pale banner 'Key revoked — undo' for 12s. better context than global toasts. For bulk revoke/rotate show a combined modal listing affected keys and require a typed confirmation when >5 items (typed 'CONFIRM').

Irina: screen-reader detail: when inline banner appears, use aria-live="assertive" if services are blocked. If banner is informational, polite. Also announce the undo action and its time window. Test with NVDA and VoiceOver.

Carlos: spacing/layout: sticky bottom-right CTA for long drawers so Create is always reachable. but on short drawers top-right is fine. Mobile: the bottom sheet should put primary action above the fold.

Mei: small copy tweak: instead of 'Create & download' use 'Create and download' on narrow screens for clarity. also add a required reminder if user tries to leave the page without acknowledging the one-time panel: 'You haven't saved your key. Are you sure?'

Hannah: QA checklist suggestions: keyboard focus trap for drawer, focus moves to textarea on reveal, copy button announces success, inline undo collapses row visually and is announced, mobile overflow separates danger, bulk rotate typed-confirmation path.

UX-bot: automated checks: focus-trap: WARN on nested drawers; aria-live for copy: MISSING; mobile hit targets: WARN. Uploaded artboard: keys-reveal-v2.fig (https://design.redwood.local/file/keys-reveal-v2)
